nodes.title: Mathematics
nodes.description: Mathematics Grade 5

nodes.title: Term 1
nodes.description: Mathematics Grade 5 Term 1

nodes.title: Whole Numbers: Counting, Ordering and Representing
nodes.description: Order, compare and represent numbers to at least 6-digit numbers. Recognise the place value of digits in whole numbers to at least 6-digit numbers. Round off to the nearest 5, 10, 100 and 1 000.

nodes.title: Number Sentences
nodes.description: Write number sentences to describe problem situations. Solve and complete number sentences by inspection, trial and improvement, and checking the solution by substitution. Properties of whole numbers: commutative, associative and distributive properties. 0 in terms of its additive property. 1 in terms of its multiplicative property.

nodes.title: Whole Numbers: Addition and Subtraction
nodes.description: Addition and subtraction of whole numbers of at least 5 digits. Calculation techniques: estimation, adding and subtracting in columns, building up and breaking down numbers, using a number line, rounding off and compensating, using addition and subtraction as inverse operations. Solving problems in financial and measurement contexts.

nodes.title: Formal Assessment Task: Assignment
nodes.description: Formal assessment task (assignment) covering whole numbers: counting, ordering and representing numbers; number sentences; whole numbers: addition and subtraction. To be completed in class within three hours.

nodes.title: Whole Numbers: Multiplication
nodes.description: Multiplication of at least whole 3-digit by 2-digit numbers. Calculation techniques: estimation, building up and breaking down numbers, doubling and halving, using multiplication and division as inverse operations. Multiples of 2-digit whole numbers to at least 100. Factors of 2-digit whole numbers to at least 100. Solving problems in financial and measurement contexts, ratio and rate.

nodes.title: Revision
nodes.description: Revision of all Term 1 topics.

nodes.title: Formal Assessment Task: Test
nodes.description: Formal assessment task: Test covering all Term 1 topics.

nodes.title: Term 2
nodes.description: Mathematics Grade 5 Term 2

nodes.title: Formal Assessment Task: Investigation
nodes.description: Formal assessment task: Investigation on any ONE of the Term 2 topics, administered before teaching that topic.

nodes.title: Whole Numbers: Division
nodes.description: Division of at least whole 3-digit by 2-digit numbers. Calculation techniques: estimation, building up and breaking down numbers, using multiplication and division as inverse operations. Solving problems in financial and measurement contexts, ratio, rate, grouping and equal sharing with remainders.

nodes.title: Common Fractions
nodes.description: Count forwards and backwards in fractions. Compare and order common fractions to at least twelfths. Addition and subtraction of common fractions with the same denominators. Addition and subtraction of mixed numbers. Fractions of whole numbers which result in whole numbers. Recognise, describe and use the equivalence of division and fractions. Solve problems in contexts involving common fractions. Recognise and use equivalent forms of common fractions.

nodes.title: Geometric Patterns
nodes.description: Investigate and extend geometric patterns looking for relationships or rules in sequences not limited to a constant difference or ratio, and of learners' own creation. Describe observed relationships or rules in learners' own words. Determine input values, output values and rules using flow diagrams. Determine equivalence of different descriptions of the same relationship or rule.

nodes.title: Numeric Patterns
nodes.description: Investigate and extend numeric patterns looking for relationships or rules in sequences involving a constant difference or ratio, and of learners' own creation. Describe observed relationships or rules in learners' own words. Determine input values, output values and rules using flow diagrams and tables. Determine equivalence of different descriptions of the same relationship or rule.

nodes.title: Properties of 2D Shapes
nodes.description: Recognise, visualise and name 2D shapes focusing on regular and irregular polygons: triangles, squares, rectangles, other quadrilaterals, pentagons, hexagons, heptagons, and circles. Describe, sort and compare 2D shapes in terms of straight and curved sides and number of sides. Draw 2D shapes on grid paper. Symmetry: recognise, draw and describe line(s) of symmetry in 2-D shapes.

nodes.title: Revision and Assessment
nodes.description: Revision and formal assessment task: Test covering all Term 1 and Term 2 topics.

nodes.title: Term 3
nodes.description: Mathematics Grade 5 Term 3

nodes.title: Formal Assessment Task: Project
nodes.description: Formal assessment task: Project covering a combination of topics from Terms 1 to 3. Must be completed before the end of Term 3.

nodes.title: Properties of 3D Objects
nodes.description: Recognise, visualise and name 3-D objects focusing on rectangular prisms and other prisms, cubes, cylinders, cones, and pyramids. Similarities and differences between cubes and rectangular prisms. Describe, sort and compare 3-D objects in terms of shape of faces, number of faces, flat and curved surfaces. Make 3-D models using cut out polygons. Cut open boxes to trace and describe their nets.

nodes.title: Data Cycle
nodes.description: Collect data using tally marks and tables; order data from smallest to largest group. Representing data: draw pictographs (many-to-one correspondence) and bar graphs. Interpreting data represented in words, pictographs, bar graphs, and pie charts. Analysing data by answering questions related to data categories, data sources and contexts. Reporting data: summarise verbally and in short written paragraphs, drawing conclusions and making predictions. Ungrouped data: determine the mode. Probability experiments: tossing a coin, rolling a die, spinning a spinner; count and compare frequency of actual outcomes for up to 20 trials.

nodes.title: Length
nodes.description: Estimate and practically measure 2D shapes and 3D objects using rulers, metre sticks, tape measures, and trundle wheels. Record, compare and order lengths in millimetres (mm), centimetres (cm), metres (m) and kilometres (km). Solve problems in contexts involving length. Convert between mm, cm, m, km (limited to whole numbers and common fractions).

nodes.title: Perimeter, Area and Volume
nodes.description: Measure perimeter using rulers or measuring tapes. Find areas of regular and irregular shapes by counting squares on grids to develop understanding of square units. Find volume/capacity of objects by packing or filling them to develop understanding of cubic units.

nodes.title: Revision and Assessment
nodes.description: Revision and formal assessment task: Test covering all Term 3 topics.

nodes.title: Term 4
nodes.description: Mathematics Grade 5 Term 4

nodes.title: Time
nodes.description: Read, tell and write time in 12-hour and 24-hour formats on analogue and digital instruments in hours, minutes, and seconds. Instruments include clocks, watches, and stopwatches. Reading calendars. Solve problems in contexts involving time. Calculate the number of days between any two dates within the same or consecutive years. Calculate time intervals given in seconds and/or minutes, minutes and/or hours, hours and/or days, days, weeks and/or months, years and/or decades.

nodes.title: Capacity and Volume
nodes.description: Estimate and practically measure 3D objects using measuring spoons, measuring cups, and measuring jugs. Record, compare and order the capacity and volume of 3D objects in millilitres (ml) and litres (l). Solve problems in contexts involving capacity/volume. Convert between millilitres and litres (limited to examples with whole numbers and fractions).

nodes.title: Mass
nodes.description: Estimate and practically measure 3D objects using bathroom scales, kitchen scales, and balances. Record, compare and order the mass in grams (g) and kilograms (kg). Solve problems in contexts involving mass. Convert between grams and kilograms limited to examples with whole numbers and fractions.

nodes.title: Transformation
nodes.description: Make composite 2-D shapes including shapes with line symmetry by tracing and moving a 2-D shape by rotation, translation, or reflection. Use transformations to make tessellations: make tessellated patterns including some patterns with line symmetry by rotation, translation, or reflection. Describe patterns referring to lines, 2-D shapes, 3-D objects, lines of symmetry, rotations, reflections and translations in nature, from modern everyday life, and from our cultural heritage.

nodes.title: Revision and Assessment
nodes.description: Revision and formal assessment task: Test covering Term 1-4 topics.
